criteria.name: Adaptive Cryptographic Password Hashing
criteria.description: All passwords hashed with Argon2id or bcrypt (work factor >= 12). Zero plaintext passwords stored or logged.

scale.3: Argon2id or bcrypt used with salted hashes. Zero plaintext passwords in storage or logs.
scale.2: Argon2id or bcrypt used, but work factor below recommended baseline.
scale.1: Legacy fast hash (MD5, SHA-256 without stretching) used for passwords.
scale.0: Plaintext passwords stored or printed in logs.

criteria.name: Secure Session Handling and Expiry
criteria.description: Session cookies configured with HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite. Sessions expire after inactivity and support server-side revocation on logout.

scale.3: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookies with idle/absolute timeouts and server-side revocation table.
scale.2: Session cookie flags set, but idle expiration logic missing.
scale.1: Missing HttpOnly or Secure cookie flags.
scale.0: Sessions stored in client-accessible localStorage without expiry or CSRF protection.

criteria.name: Login Rate Limiting and Lockout
criteria.description: Rate limiting enforced on login/reset endpoints to prevent brute-force credential stuffing (max 5 attempts/minute).

scale.3: Token bucket or sliding window rate limiting returning HTTP 429 after 5 failed attempts.
scale.2: Rate limiting present but threshold too generous (> 20 attempts/min).
scale.0: No rate limiting on login or authentication endpoints.

criteria.name: Server-Side RBAC and Ownership Enforcement
criteria.description: Object ownership checked on every data query (WHERE id = $1 AND owner_id = $2). Role authorization checked at route boundary.

scale.3: Rigorous server-side RBAC and ownership filtering on 100% of resource queries and updates.
scale.2: Role checked, but one resource endpoint lacks explicit owner_id filter.
scale.1: Client-supplied role or user ID trusted without session validation.
scale.0: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA) detected on protected routes.
